interactivehtmlbom.name: InteractiveHtmlBom
interactivehtmlbom.purpose: Interactive HTML assembly BOM with board view
known_limitations: Reflects the board as saved; re-generate after every change.
Optional in the kit's export: missing plugin gives SKIPPED, not a failure.

freerouting.name: Freerouting
freerouting.kicad10: PCM 2.4.1 declares kicad_version 6.0 with no maximum (checked 2026-10-18)
known_limitations: Routes only what the DSN describes; review every result with DRC and engineering judgement.
Not suitable as a substitute for routing of high-speed, analog or power paths.
The kit never invokes it on user boards automatically.

kikit.name: KiKit
kikit.kicad10: PCM 1.6.0 action shim declares kicad_version 7.0, no maximum; backend is the kikit Python package in KiCad's bundled Python
optional_dependencies: kikit Python package in KiCad's bundled Python
known_limitations: The PCM package is only an action shim without the backend package.

kibuzzard.name: KiBuzzard
kibuzzard.kicad10: PCM 1.7.0 declares kicad_version 6.0 with no maximum (checked 2026-10-18)
kibuzzard.purpose: Text/label graphics for silkscreen and copper
known_limitations: GUI action plugin; not verified headlessly by the kit.

board2pdf.name: Board2Pdf
known_limitations: GUI action plugin in this kit; the kit's assembly PDFs use kicad-cli instead.

kibot.name: KiBot
kibot.kicad10: Not a PCM package; needs an interpreter that imports pcbnew (KiCad's bundled Python on macOS)
optional_dependencies: Interpreter that imports pcbnew (KiCad's bundled Python)
known_limitations: Not a PCM package; overlaps with the kit's own export pipeline.

pcb_action_tools.name: pcb-action-tools
pcb_action_tools.kicad10: PCM 1.0.7 declares kicad_version 8.0 with no maximum (checked 2026-10-18)
pcb_action_tools.purpose: Collection of pcbnew action tools (e.g. footprint/track helpers)
known_limitations: GUI action plugins; KiCad 10 compatibility only declared, not verified by the kit.

round_tracks.name: Round Tracks
round_tracks.kicad10: PCM 1.6 declares kicad_version 7.0.1 with no maximum (checked 2026-10-18)
known_limitations: Cosmetic/geometric change of routed copper: re-run DRC afterwards.
Rounded corners are not an electrical requirement for ordinary signals.

hq_dfm.name: HQ DFM
hq_dfm.kicad10: PCM 2.0.11 declares kicad_version 9.0 with no maximum (checked 2026-10-18)
hq_dfm.purpose: Design-for-manufacturing analysis from a PCB manufacturer (Huaqiu)
known_limitations: Manufacturer-specific rules; results do not transfer to other fabricators.
Check whether it contacts external services before using it on confidential designs.
